description: Verniquet map" and "Jacoubet Atlas" Paris street networks is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors GeoHistoricalData. This dataset consists of geohistorical street networks extracted from two topographical maps of Paris, refereed as "Verniquet map" and "Jacoubet Atlas", respectively created at the scale of 1:8000 between 1783 and 1799, and at the scale of 1:2000 between 1825 and 1837. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
